summary.text: Immortal Binding Vine is Chen Yi's immortal killer move. Jade green light threads become vines that bind a target and recover quickly when cut.

claims.text: In Lang Ya blessed land, Chen Yi points at the silver giant of ancient battle formation Heavenly Giant Solor. Its punch is obstructed, so the blow is slow and changes direction, crashing into cloud soil. He stays in the air, still pointing. Inside the formation, Lang Ya land spirit shouts in anger: the move seems to have countered him entirely, and even with great strength he cannot use any of it properly.

Sixth Hair uses an immortal killer move. Golden light appears on Heavenly Giant Solor, and the immortal binding vines are cut apart inch by inch. Bound, the giant cannot move away. When it finally breaks free of the vines, it is immediately trapped in the distinct killer move ancient tree prison cage.

Chen Yi uses immortal binding vine again on the immemorial rock dragon. The vines extend around it and restrict it, though it still charges at the four Central Continent immortals before he follows with ancient tree prison cage. Without external help the dragon cannot break out of the immortal binding vines, as the restriction grows thicker and tighter despite intense struggle.

The immemorial rock dragon remains trapped in the immortal binding vines, with little hope of escaping. After Thunder Ghost True Monarch leaves the battlefield, the silver giant is still restricted by the vine and cannot move, even though many layers have been pulled off.
